summary: Jefferies Credit Partners BDC Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 Other Events solely to declare a regular cash distribution on its Class I and Class S common stock. For Class I shares the gross distribution is $0.1149 per share with no servicing/distribution fee, netting $0.1149; for Class S shares the gross is $0.1145, a $0.0100 fee is deducted, yielding $0.1045 net. The distribution is payable July 20, 2026 to holders of record June 29, 2026, and may be paid in cash or reinvested under the company's distribution reinvestment plan. There is no mention of any merger, acquisition, tender offer, restructuring, or other special situation. This is a routine dividend declaration with no deal terms or strategic event; it does not meet the threshold for a special-situation classification.
